newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish bond yields end mixed, long end higher.
newsitem.headline: Swedish bond yields end mixed, long end higher.

text.p: Swedish yields ended mixed on Thursday but the crown was marginally stronger and expected to firm further on Friday.

Strong U.S. data raised longer yields one or two basis points whereas the shorter end fell, on Riksbank deputy-governor Lars Heikensten's comments that a temporarily weak crown would not necessarily mean inflation.
The crown strengthened marginally to 4.5015 crowns to the mark compared to 4.5090 on Wednesday.
"I think the crown will gain some ground. We have had some positive signals today", one dealer said.
He was referring to a statement from employers and unions in the retail industry, extending for three years a current wage agreement with moderate pay-rises.
Tomorrow's focus is on US producer price, industrial production and capacity utilization data.
The six month T-bill rate fell three basis points to 4.27 percent and the 10-year bond yield gained three basis points to 6.91 percent.
